integrity: The publication date and provenance of the foundational model were checked in bibliographic records and the public reduced-model repository. The standard two-dimensional equations were checked in an authoritative model description. A full open slow-fast Morris–Lecar treatment and a full recent same-object probability-measure study were searched for invariant-measure, variance, average, and conditional formulations. The conditional regressions, variance defects, equality cases, and crossing consequences were independently reconstructed, and the algebra was replayed from the packaged exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures for the autonomous two-dimensional Morris–Lecar model with constant applied current.
The recovery-gate regression is under the positive rate-tilted measure rather than the original stationary measure unless the gate rate is constant.
The result does not determine firing frequency, period, bifurcation threshold, phase response, or the full invariant density.
The original 1981 full text was not stably retrievable in the inspected route; exact reduced equations were checked in later authoritative model descriptions.
An equivalent short stationary-moment observation could remain in unindexed computational-neuroscience literature.
title: Exact stationary nullcline regressions and speed defects in the Morris–Lecar oscillator
